argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='openocd.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,Name)
$devices=@(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'OK' -and $_.FriendlyName -match '(CMSIS.DAP|DAPLink)' } | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName,InstanceId)
[pscustomobject]@{processes=$procs;devices=$devices}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
